text:
```yaml
name: CodeQL

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 * * 1' # Monday at 06:00 UTC

jobs:
  analyze:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Initialize CodeQL
      uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3
      with:
        languages: 'javascript-typescript,python'
        token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        analysis-kinds: 'security'

    - name: Autobuild
      uses: github/codeql-action/autobuild@v3
      with:
        build-mode: 'autobuild'

    - name: Perform CodeQL Analysis
      uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3
      with:
        upload: true
        cleanup-level: 'full'

    - name: Stop CodeQL Runs on News Branch
      if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/news'
      run: |
        echo "::set-output name=stop::true"
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

    - name: Upload SARIF Results
      if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.head.ref != 'news'
      uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v4
      with:
        sarif_file: 'results.sarif'
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
